advisor.title: Color suggestions

descriptions.shades: Lighter and darker versions of the source color for backgrounds or stronger accents.
descriptions.analogous: The source color and two hues 30° to either side, for exploring a close color combination.
descriptions.accents: Explore stronger differences with an opposite hue or two evenly spaced hues.

complementary.title: Complementary
complementary.description: A hue opposite the source on the color wheel (180°).

triadic.title: Triad
triadic.description: Two hues spaced 120° from the source form a three-color combination.

advisor.neutral: This color is black, white, or close to gray. Try its shades, or choose a more colorful source to explore hue combinations.
advisor.guidance: These are starting points, not guaranteed matches. The result depends on proportions, background, and use. Text readability is not evaluated.
